name: alumni-outcomes
title: Alumni outcomes
description: Graduate stories for courses and coaching: where they started, where they work now and how long it took, with a disclaimer built in.
docs: Pass title, an optional description, alumni ({ id, name, from, to, duration, quote, employer?, photo? }) and note, the disclaimer printed under the list ('Individual results vary'); outcome claims need context, so it is required, and null is only for when you have checked that nothing needs saying. Each card is a portrait and name, a result panel with a From line and a To line joined by an arrow with the time it took on the rail between them, and one sentence in their own words. A screen reader hears 'Before: Barista', 'Time it took: 9 months' and 'After: Frontend developer, Northwind', so the arrow is never the only signal. Two columns on a desktop, one on a phone. labels carries the fixed words.
